3. The plaintiffs' case, in short, is that Bhabani Charan Laha was the owner of 48 decimals of land of CS; Khatian No.440 as described in schedule "Ka" to the plaint. Bahabani Charan Laha settled this 48 decimals of land in favour of Khalilur Rahman and Biadhan Bia by a registered' kabuliyat dated 29.01.1943. Biadhan Bia by a kabala executed on 01.11.1951 and registered on 22.02.1952 sold 63/4  decimals of land of suit plot No.2687 along with 23/4   decimals of land of other plot to Sirajul Islam and handed over possession of the said land to him. Sirajul Islam subsequently sold out the said purchased 93/4   decimals of land to Dallier Rahman and Anna Khatun. Both Dallier Rahman and Amta Khatun died leaving behind six sons and four daughters. Daliler Rahman also left behind his wife named Najmun Bia. Shamsher Dulal, the eldest son of Daliler Rahman being the only adult child applied to the District Judge's Court for being appointed as guardian of his minor siblings and was appointed the guardian in Title Suit No.41 of 1980 and thereafter in Miscellaneous Case No.260 of 1988 Shamsher Dulal was granted permission to sell 115/16 , and on behalf of minors. On 24.11.1979 Shamsher Dulal sold decimals of land from schedule "Kha" to each of the plaintiff No.1 and Daliler Rahman. On 26.11.1979 Najmun Bia sold 3/4 decimals to plaintiff No.1 and Dallier Rahman, the predecessor of the plaintiff Nos.2 to 6. On 29.04.1984 Shamsher Dulal on his own behalf and on behalf of his minor siblings sold 21/8 deeimals of land to plaintiff No.1 and Dallier Rahman. On 24.04.1967 Jalal Ahmed, son of Khaliler Rahman, by a registered kabala sold 63/4decimals of land to Bailer Rahman. 

 8. We have heard Mr. Abdur Razzak, the learned Counsel for the petitioners and gone through the judgments. In this case the quantum of disputed land is 6 decimals of plot No.2687 of C.S., Khatian No.440 of mouza Farhad Nagar within P.S. Feni. Out of these 6 decimals of land 2 decimals have been described in schedule "Kha" to the plaint and 4 decimals have been described in schedule "Ga" to the plaint. The plaintiffs have prayed for declaration of their title and confirmation of possession in 2 decimals of land described in schedule "Kha" and declaration of title and also recovery of possession in 4 decimals of land described in schedule "Ga" to the plaint. Admittedly these 6 decimals of land belonged to Biadhan Bia. Biadhan Bia and Kaliler Rahman took settlement of 48 decimals of land including the entire 13 decimals of land of suit plot No.2687 from Bhabani Charan Laha by registered kabuliyat dated 29.01.1943. So Biadhan Bia was the owner of 61/2, decimals of land of this plot No.2687. In this suit both the contesting parties arc claiming the suit land from Biadhan Bia. The plaintiffs have claimed that Biadhan Bia sold out 63/4, decimals of land of this suit plot No.2687 along with some other lands to Sirajul Islam by a registered kahala which was executed on 01.11.1951 and registered on 22.02.1952. On the other hand, the defendants case is that Biadhan Bia sold out 61/2, decimals of land of this plot No.2687 to Bailer Rahman by registered kabala which was executed on 25.11.1951 and registered on 10.12.1951. So the sole question arose for determination in this suit was which of these 2-kabalas of the contesting parties was valid.
